sloka: ततः कलापान् सम्नह्य खड्गौ बद्ध्वा च धन्विनौ ।जग्मतुर् येन तौ गन्गाम् सीतया सह राघवौ ॥२-५२-११॥
transliteration: tataḥ kalāpān samnahya khaḍgau baddhvā ca dhanvinau ।jagmatur yena tau gangām sītayā saha rāghavau ॥2-52-11॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana then put on their quivers, fastened their swords and holding their bows went towards Ganga along with Sita.
translations.hindi: अनेक जप, तप ओर यज्ञानुष्ठान के बाद महाराज के उन जैसे लक्षणों बाले यही तो एक प्रिय पुत्र हुए हैं
